lemma exists_trial (N n:ℕ)(b:ℝ)(h: |b|< radius S) :
    (∃! β:ℝ,S.Trial N n b β) ∧ RG.Shoot.Competes A.B.bake n N 0 (S.realBeat b N n) ∧ (S.realBeat b N n 0).beta=A.B.a.clock.bar+b ∧
      (∀ β:ℝ,S.Trial N n b β → betaK S N n N (b:ℂ)= Complex.ofReal β) :=by
   have hp: (b:ℂ)∈Camp.Broad a!:=mem_ball_zero_iff.mpr ((Complex.norm_real b).trans_lt h)
   exact ⟨⟨_, S.terminates N n hp, fun β=> S.only N n hp⟩,S.ticking N n hp, S.hits N n hp, fun β ht=> (S.only N n hp ht).symm ▸ ((real S N n N le_rfl b hp).2.2.2.2.2.1)⟩

proof_context.conclusion: For every |b| < `radius S` there is a unique real β with a `Trial` ending at bar + b, the `realBeat b` trajectory competes and hits bar + b, and `betaK` at N equals it.

lemma speed (k:ℕ): dist ((V.veil T N X b)^[k] 0) (V.picked h T N X hf (b:=b)) ≤ rad*(1/2)^k/(1-1/2):= by
    unfold picked; rw [dif_pos hv]; let f:= V.harp h T N X hf b hv; have hh:= V.harps h T N X hf hv; let j: Harbor N:=⟨0,harbor N⟩
    have he := hh.apriori_dist_iterate_fixedPoint_le j k
    have hF (n:ℕ): (V.veil T N X b)^[n] 0 = (f^[n] j).val:= by
      induction n with
      | zero=>rfl
      | succ n hn=> rw [iterate_succ_apply',iterate_succ_apply',hn]; rfl
    rw [hF]
    have hg: dist j (f j) ≤ rad:= by change dist (0:PlotN N) _ ≤ _; rw [dist_comm]; exact mem_closedBall.mp (f j).2
    exact he.trans (by push_cast; exact div_le_div_of_nonneg_right (mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hg (by positivity)) (by norm_num))

proof_context.conclusion: Successive substitution `veil^[k] 0` converges geometrically (rate 1/2) to the fixed point `picked`.

lemma canon : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun b:ℂ=> V.picked h T N X hf (b:=b)) (Broad T):=by
   let f i (b:ℂ):= (V.veil T N X b)^[i] 0
   let s:=Broad T
   have hs(i): MapsTo (f i) s (Harbor N):=by intro b hv; induction i with | zero=> exact harbor N | succ i hi=> change _^[i+1] _∈_; rw [iterate_succ_apply']; exact V.access h T N X hf hv hi
   have ht(i):DifferentiableOn ℂ (f i) s:= by
      induction i with
      | zero=> exact differentiableOn_const _
      | succ i hi=> unfold f; simp_rw [iterate_succ_apply']; exact V.warmth T N X s isOpen_ball _ (hs i) hi
   have he: TendstoUniformlyOn f (fun b=> V.picked h T N X hf (b:=b)) atTop s:=by
     refine Metric.tendstoUniformlyOn_iff.mpr (fun ε he=> ?_); have H:Tendsto (fun k:ℕ=>rad*(1/2)^k/(1-1/2)) atTop (𝓝 0):= by
       simpa only [mul_zero,zero_div] using (((tendsto_pow_atTop_nhds_zero_of_lt_one (by norm_num : 0≤ (1/2:ℝ)) (by norm_num)).const_mul rad).div_const ((1:ℝ)-1/2))
     filter_upwards [H.eventually (gt_mem_nhds he)] with i hi k hk; rw [dist_comm]; exact lt_of_le_of_lt (speed h T N X V hf hk i) hi
   exact he.tendstoLocallyUniformlyOn.differentiableOn (Eventually.of_forall ht) isOpen_ball

proof_context.conclusion: `picked` is complex-differentiable in b on `Broad T` as a uniform limit of the iterates.

lemma real (m n N)(h:m≤N)(b:ℝ)(hp: (b:ℂ) ∈ ball (0:ℂ) (Upland.Arc.radius S)): let R:= S.realBeat b N n m
     R.path=A.B.kin.path N m ∧ R.clip=((A.B.a.params m)).clip ∧ R.p=A.B.a.budget m ∧
     R.activities.reg=(drawer G _).reg ∧ R.activities.forced=Ovens.Pipes.addr (folio G _) (A.B.a.budget m) ∧ betaK S m n N (b:ℂ)=Complex.ofReal R.beta ∧
     Arc.view S m n N (b:ℂ)=tuning (A.B.a.budget m) (A.B.a.clock.allowance m) (A.B.a.clock.forcedAllowance m) (R.activities.E,R.activities.K):=by
   intro J; refine ⟨rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,rfl,?_,?_⟩
   · rw [betaK,dif_pos h]; exact ((S.fits _ _).really (S.cart ..) (S.token ..) S.grove.coins hp m h).1
   rw [Arc.view,dif_pos h]; exact (S.fits _ _).realX (S.cart ..) (S.token ..) S.grove.coins hp m h

proof_context.conclusion: For real b in the ball, `betaK` at b equals the real bare coupling of `realBeat b` (real values of the analytic series).
